preconditions: Populate targetContract.targets from a fresh read-only control-plane inventory.
Record unit or job definition bytes, owner, scope, enablement, active state, schedule, last result, and dependency edges.
Hash the complete inventory and each exact target definition before any mutation.
Prove each target is obsolete and is not an active user reminder or required release surface.
Acquire explicit control-plane approval for the populated target list and inventory digest.

steps: Re-read the exact target and require its digest and state to match the approved inventory.
Copy the definition, schedule, state, dependency metadata, and recovery owner into the quarantine root.
Write and fsync a per-target manifest before disabling anything.
Disable and stop only the exact approved timer, service, or cron identity; do not delete its source or quarantine copy.
Verify the target is no longer scheduled and unrelated jobs are byte-for-byte and state-for-state unchanged.
Append the result to an immutable application receipt.
forbiddenActions: mutating a target whose digest changed after approval

steps: Verify the quarantine manifest and definition digests.
Refuse recovery if an active replacement owns the same schedule or identity.
Restore the exact definition to its recorded scope without changing payload bytes.
Reload only the affected scheduler and restore prior enabled and active states.
Run one bounded status check without triggering the recovered job payload.
Append a recovery receipt linking the quarantine and recovery digests.

truthBoundary: This file defines a later control-plane transaction. It does not identify live stale jobs, authorize live mutation, disable any timer or cron entry, or prove OPS-2 applied.
